# Collectron: Lumberjack

__Collectron: Lumberjack__

Embrace great American lumber with your own Lumberjack Collectron.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

**Produces**

Wood Scrap

Super Common Junk

Uncommon Junk

Rare Junk

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

All other Collectrons.

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

1 Pound

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - - Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 Minutes and 12 Seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
